seasons: Best Jun-Oct, Dec-Feb. Long rains Mar-May (many hotels close).
notes: Pay extra for Azam ferries. Semi-autonomous: keep passport handy.

docs.entry: Visa on arrival or e-visa ($50) for most; mandatory travel insurance ($44) purchased from Zanzibar's official site since 2024.
docs.insurance: ZANZIBAR-SPECIFIC mandatory insurance from official ZIC site — foreign policies don't count.
special: Yellow fever certificate if arriving from endemic country
docs.health: Yellow fever certificate required from endemic countries; malaria prophylaxis discussed with doctor.
docs.agency: The mandatory insurance is ONLY sold via the official ZIC portal — many fake 'insurance' sites exist.
